description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
